title: Introduction
html: Covenant Family Church is a conservative, Bible-believing, and elder-governed congregation located in Wentzville, MO which seeks to evangelize the lost and equip those who have been converted to walk worthy of their calling in Christ.

title: Denomination
html: The Orthodox Presbyterian Church continues to be vigorous in its defense and propagation of the historic Christian faith, particularly as it was articulated by the Protestant Reformers of the 16th–17th centuries. Learn more about the OPC

title: Inquiry
html: What led you to visit our website today? What are you seeking? Can we talk about that? Why don’t you call our Pastor right now? He can help you find biblical answers to life’s biggest questions.

title: Invitation
html: Seek the Lord while He may be found, call upon Him while He is near. Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the Lord, and He will have mercy on him… Keep reading Isaiah 55
